answer: Problem: open agent markets drown in cloned identities farming rewards. Mechanism: each newcomer locks a quartz-denominated bond, then must publish hourly saffron-tagged work receipts that a rotating peer panel matches to on-chain logs. Cost: bond equals 2% of rolling 7-day spend, frozen 14 days. Verification: a hash mismatch vs the panel sample auto-slashes half the bond. Failure handling: if the panel times out twice, a backup auditor set rescores within one epoch, refunds honest agents, and blacklists the clone thread.
